title: AE/CSM 1:1 Prep — Mar 4 2026
content:
Purpose: prep notes for weekly AE/CSM 1:1 with Jordan (AE) on Acme Analytics (Strategic) — align on renewal health, open technical blockers, pricing ask, and next steps.

Meeting goals (top 3):
- Decide negotiation stance for renewal (target: 12-mo + growth commit)
- Confirm owners and timeline for private deployment POC request
- Identify quick wins to increase usage and cross-sell roadmap features

Quick context summary (for Jordan):
- Customer: Acme Analytics (ML-heavy analytics SaaS). Current plan: Dedicated 2x GPUs reserved, hosted fallback. Renewal due 2026-05-15.
- Usage: token volume down ~18% MoM across Feb; main drop in embedding usage from their recommendation engine (they report quality regressions).
- Incidents: Two latency spikes in Feb (3/2/10 mins) after model rollout to v2.1 — resolved by rollback; they want stronger SLA/alerting and playbook.
- Ask from customer this week: POC for Private deployment (VPC) + quantized model variant to reduce latency/cost, and a pricing concession tied to growth commits.
- Exec sponsor: VP Eng (Lina Morales) — engaged but wants clearer cost/impact case.

Discussion prompts / agenda items:
1) Renewal posture: based on usage and incident history, propose: 12-mo renewal with 10% discount in exchange for 15% YOY growth commit and quarterly QBRs + improved SLOs. Ask Jordan: are we comfortable with 10%? do we need CS/RevOps signoff?
2) POC scope and timeline: outline POC success criteria (latency < 150ms p95 for 95% of traffic; token cost -25% for embeddings), estimate infra/time (approx 3 weeks engineering + infra), propose internal owners: Samira (solutions eng) for infra runbook, me (Avery) for CS coordination, Jordan for commercial.
3) Incident root-cause + mitigation: confirm we will deliver a postmortem and a tailored alerting/playbook before renewal discussion. Note: request SRE/serving-runtime to add a per-route tracing hook for Acme.
4) Cross-sell/opportunities: feature flagging Redwood Optimize suggestions into their staging; upsell idea: rollout of caching + prefix caching for recommendation flows to lower unit cost.
5) Pricing negotiation tactics: reference benchmark (similar accounts converted to Dedicated + Private saved ~30% cost at scale). Bring RevOps numbers next sync.

Open questions I want Jordan to answer during 1:1:
- Has AE had any informal commitment from Lina on pricing flexibility?
- Which internal exec will sign off on Private POC (security/infra)?
- Can we get a representative sample dataset to run local perf tests before POC?

Notes to self / prep checklist before meeting:
- Pull usage dashboard and token trends (SaaS console) — done? pending (ask analytics)
- Draft renewal term options (3 variants: conservative, standard, aggressive) — attach to convo
- Book follow-up technical deep-dive with Samira + Acme SE by EOD Fri
- Prepare short one-pager on Private deployment security and compliance benefits for Lina

Risk register (short):
- Risk: customer pauses growth due to regression in recommendation quality -> Mitigation: prioritize evals on the embedding model, run AB test with previous model and collect metrics; set rollback guardrails.
- Risk: budget constraints -> Mitigation: tiered pricing + limited-time discount tied to commit.

Planned action items (for meeting to confirm):
- Present renewal options and recommended play (owner: Jordan + Avery)
- Confirm POC scope + timeline and owners (owner: Samira/Avery)
- Request dataset/sample from customer (owner: Jordan)
- Schedule technical deep-dive w/ Acme SE and Solutions Eng (owner: Avery)

Preferred next steps (post-1:1):
- Send recap email with agreed items within 24 hours (owner: Avery)
- Create JIRA epic for Private POC and link to account (owner: Samira)
- Draft customer-facing one-pager on cost/benefit for Lina (owner: Avery)

Meeting logistics:
- Time: scheduled 2026-03-04 10:00am PT (30 min)
- Attendees expected: Jordan (AE), Avery (CSM), optional: Samira (SE)

Talking points / soundbites:
- "We see a small dip in usage but also an opportunity to improve unit economics quickly with prefix caching + quantized variant."
- "We want to make renewal simple — tangible guarantees: shorter remediation windows, quarterly QBRs, and a price aligned to growth."
- "POC goal: demonstrate Private deployment reduces p95 latency and embedding cost within 3 weeks so you can decide on longer-term commitment."

Prepared docs to attach:
- quick POC scope draft (internal)
- renewal tier options (internal)
- incident timeline notes (internal)

Last-minute reminders: be empathetic about their infra/production anxiety; come prepared with concrete timelines (dates), not vague promises.

-- end of notes --
action_items: By 2026-03-05: Avery to send recap email summarizing meeting decisions and owner list (owner: Avery Chen)
By 2026-03-06: Jordan to request sample dataset from Acme and confirm exec signoff path (owner: Jordan Patel)
By 2026-03-10: Samira to draft POC runbook + estimate (owner: Samira Gomez)
By 2026-03-12: RevOps to provide pricing comps for similar-sized accounts (owner: RevOps - assign)
By 2026-03-18: Create JIRA epic for Private POC and link Confluence docs (owner: Samira)
Weekly: monitor usage dashboard and flag any additional drop >= 10% MoM (owner: Avery)
Schedule: Technical deep-dive w/ Acme SE and Solutions Eng — target by 2026-03-09 (owner: Avery)
